name: adjust_int_max_str_digits
doc: This function returns a context manager that will change the global sys.set_int_max_str_digits() setting for the duration of the context to allow execution of test code that needs a different limit on the number of digits when converting between an integer and string.

name: ALWAYS_EQ
doc: Object that is equal to anything. Used to test mixed type comparison.

name: anticipate_failure
doc: A decorator to conditionally mark tests with @unittest.expectedFailure. Any use of this decorator should have an associated comment identifying the relevant tracker issue.

name: args_from_interpreter_flags
doc: Return a list of command line arguments reproducing the current settings in sys.flags and sys.warnoptions.

name: bigaddrspacetest
doc: Decorator for tests that fill the address space.

name: bigmemtest
doc: Decorator for bigmem tests.

name: busy_retry
doc: Run the loop body until break stops the loop.

name: calcobjsize
doc: Return the size of the PyObject whose structure members are defined by fmt. The returned value includes the size of the Python object header and alignment.

name: calcvobjsize
doc: Return the size of the PyVarObject whose structure members are defined by fmt. The returned value includes the size of the Python object header and alignment.

name: captured_stderr
doc: A context managers that temporarily replaces the named stream with io.StringIO object.

name: captured_stdin
doc: A context managers that temporarily replaces the named stream with io.StringIO object.

name: captured_stdout
doc: A context managers that temporarily replaces the named stream with io.StringIO object.

name: catch_unraisable_exception
doc: Context manager catching unraisable exception using sys.unraisablehook().

name: check__all__
doc: Assert that the __all__ variable of module contains all public names.

name: check_disallow_instantiation
doc: Assert that type tp cannot be instantiated using args and kwds.

name: check_free_after_iterating
doc: Assert instances of cls are deallocated after iterating.

name: check_impl_detail
doc: Use this check to guard CPython’s implementation-specific tests or to run them only on the implementations guarded by the arguments. This function returns True or False depending on the host platform. Example usage:

name: check_syntax_error
doc: Test for syntax errors in statement by attempting to compile statement. testcase is the unittest instance for the test. errtext is the regular expression which should match the string representation of the raised SyntaxError. If lineno is not None, compares to the line of the exception. If offset is not None, compares to the offset of the exception.

name: checksizeof
doc: For testcase test, assert that the sys.getsizeof for o plus the GC header size equals size.

name: cpython_only
doc: Decorator for tests only applicable to CPython.

name: detect_api_mismatch
doc: Returns the set of attributes, functions or methods of ref_api not found on other_api, except for a defined list of items to be ignored in this check specified in ignore.

name: disable_faulthandler
doc: A context manager that temporary disables faulthandler.

name: disable_gc
doc: A context manager that disables the garbage collector on entry. On exit, the garbage collector is restored to its prior state.

name: findfile
doc: Return the path to the file named filename. If no match is found filename is returned. This does not equal a failure since it could be the path to the file.

name: flush_std_streams
doc: Call the flush() method on sys.stdout and then on sys.stderr. It can be used to make sure that the logs order is consistent before writing into stderr.

name: gc_collect
doc: Force as many objects as possible to be collected. This is needed because timely deallocation is not guaranteed by the garbage collector. This means that __del__ methods may be called later than expected and weakrefs may remain alive for longer than expected.

name: get_attribute
doc: Get an attribute, raising unittest.SkipTest if AttributeError is raised.

name: get_original_stdout
doc: Return the original stdout set by record_original_stdout() or sys.stdout if it’s not set.

name: get_pagesize
doc: Get size of a page in bytes.

name: get_resource_value
doc: Return the value specified for resource (as -u resource=value). Return None if resource is disabled or no value is specified.

name: HAVE_DOCSTRINGS
doc: Set to True if function docstrings are available. See the python -OO option, which strips docstrings of functions implemented in Python.

name: impl_detail
doc: Decorator for invoking check_impl_detail() on guards. If that returns False, then uses msg as the reason for skipping the test.

name: INTERNET_TIMEOUT
doc: Timeout in seconds for network requests going to the internet.

name: is_android
doc: True if sys.platform is android.

name: is_apple
doc: True if sys.platform is darwin or is_apple_mobile is True.

name: is_apple_mobile
doc: True if sys.platform is ios, tvos, or watchos.

name: is_emscripten
doc: True if sys.platform is emscripten.

name: is_jython
doc: True if the running interpreter is Jython.

name: is_resource_enabled
doc: Return True if resource is enabled and available. The list of available resources is only set when test.regrtest is executing the tests.

name: is_wasi
doc: True if sys.platform is wasi.

name: runInSubprocess
doc: Decorator that runs the decorated test in a fresh interpreter subprocess, in isolation, so that it does not share global or interpreter state with the rest of the test run. It can decorate a test method or a whole TestCase subclass. Decorated methods must take no extra arguments. A failure, error or skip in the subprocess is reported for the corresponding test, and individual subtests that fail or are skipped are reported individually. A reported failure or error shows the original subprocess traceback as the cause of the exception.

name: runningInSubprocess
doc: True while the code runs in the isolated subprocess spawned by runInSubprocess(), and False otherwise (including in the parent process and in a normal, non-isolated test run). Fixtures such as setUp(), tearDown(), setUpClass(), tearDownClass(), setUpModule() and tearDownModule() can test it to choose which code to run in the subprocess.

name: LARGEST
doc: Object that is greater than anything (except itself). Used to test mixed type comparison.

name: linked_to_musl
doc: Return False if there is no evidence the interpreter was compiled with musl, otherwise return a version triple, either (0, 0, 0) if the version is unknown, or the actual version if it is known. Intended for use in skip decorators. emscripten and wasi are assumed to be compiled with musl; otherwise platform.libc_ver is checked.

name: load_package_tests
doc: Generic implementation of the unittest load_tests protocol for use in test packages. pkg_dir is the root directory of the package; loader, standard_tests, and pattern are the arguments expected by load_tests. In simple cases, the test package’s __init__.py can be the following:

name: LONG_TIMEOUT
doc: Timeout in seconds to detect when a test hangs.

name: LOOPBACK_TIMEOUT
doc: Timeout in seconds for tests using a network server listening on the network local loopback interface like 127.0.0.1.

name: match_value
doc: Try to match a single stored value (dv) with a supplied value (v).

name: matches
doc: Try to match a single dict with the supplied arguments.

name: max_memuse
doc: Set by set_memlimit() as the memory limit for big memory tests. Limited by MAX_Py_ssize_t.

name: MAX_Py_ssize_t
doc: Set to sys.maxsize for big memory tests.

name: MISSING_C_DOCSTRINGS
doc: Set to True if Python is built without docstrings (the WITH_DOC_STRINGS macro is not defined). See the configure --without-doc-strings option.

name: missing_compiler_executable
doc: Check for the existence of the compiler executables whose names are listed in cmd_names or all the compiler executables when cmd_names is empty and return the first missing executable or None when none is found missing.

name: NEVER_EQ
doc: Object that is not equal to anything (even to ALWAYS_EQ). Used to test mixed type comparison.

name: no_tracing
doc: Decorator to temporarily turn off tracing for the duration of the test.

name: open_urlresource
doc: Open url. If open fails, raises TestFailed.

name: optim_args_from_interpreter_flags
doc: Return a list of command line arguments reproducing the current optimization settings in sys.flags.

name: patch
doc: Override object_to_patch.attr_name with new_value. Also add cleanup procedure to test_instance to restore object_to_patch for attr_name. The attr_name should be a valid attribute for object_to_patch.

name: PGO
doc: Set when tests can be skipped when they are not useful for PGO.

name: PIPE_MAX_SIZE
doc: A constant that is likely larger than the underlying OS pipe buffer size, to make writes blocking.

name: print_warning
doc: Print a warning into sys.__stderr__. Format the message as: f"Warning -- {msg}". If msg is made of multiple lines, add "Warning -- " prefix to each line.

name: Py_DEBUG
doc: True if Python was built with the Py_DEBUG macro defined, that is, if Python was built in debug mode.

name: python_is_optimized
doc: Return True if Python was not built with -O0 or -Og.

name: real_max_memuse
doc: Set by set_memlimit() as the memory limit for big memory tests. Not limited by MAX_Py_ssize_t.

name: reap_children
doc: Call this from setUp(), tearDown(), or tearDownModule() in tests that start subprocesses. This will help ensure that no extra children (zombies) stick around to hog resources and create problems when looking for refleaks.

name: record_original_stdout
doc: Store the value from stdout. It is meant to hold the stdout at the time the regrtest began.

name: refcount_test
doc: Decorator for tests which involve reference counting. The decorator does not run the test if it is not run by CPython. Any trace function is unset for the duration of the test to prevent unexpected refcounts caused by the trace function.

name: requires
doc: Raise ResourceDenied if resource is not available. msg is the argument to ResourceDenied if it is raised. Always returns True if called by a function whose __name__ is '__main__'. Used when tests are executed by test.regrtest.

name: requires_bz2
doc: Decorator for skipping tests if bz2 doesn’t exist.

name: requires_docstrings
doc: Decorator for only running the test if HAVE_DOCSTRINGS.

name: requires_freebsd_version
doc: Decorator for the minimum version when running test on FreeBSD. If the FreeBSD version is less than the minimum, the test is skipped.

name: requires_gil_enabled
doc: Decorator for skipping tests on the free-threaded build. If the GIL is disabled, the test is skipped.

name: requires_gzip
doc: Decorator for skipping tests if gzip doesn’t exist.

name: requires_IEEE_754
doc: Decorator for skipping tests on non-IEEE 754 platforms.

name: requires_limited_api
doc: Decorator for only running the test if Limited C API is available.

name: requires_linux_version
doc: Decorator for the minimum version when running test on Linux. If the Linux version is less than the minimum, the test is skipped.

name: requires_lzma
doc: Decorator for skipping tests if lzma doesn’t exist.

name: requires_mac_version
doc: Decorator for the minimum version when running test on macOS. If the macOS version is less than the minimum, the test is skipped.

name: requires_resource
doc: Decorator for skipping tests if resource is not available.

name: requires_zlib
doc: Decorator for skipping tests if zlib doesn’t exist.

name: ResourceDenied
doc: Subclass of unittest.SkipTest. Raised when a resource (such as a network connection) is not available. Raised by the requires() function.

name: run_in_subinterp
doc: Run code in subinterpreter. Raise unittest.SkipTest if tracemalloc is enabled.

name: run_with_locale
doc: A decorator for running a function in a different locale, correctly resetting it after it has finished. catstr is the locale category as a string (for example "LC_ALL"). The locales passed will be tried sequentially, and the first valid locale will be used.

name: run_with_tz
doc: A decorator for running a function in a specific timezone, correctly resetting it after it has finished.

name: SaveSignals
doc: Class to save and restore signal handlers registered by the Python signal handler.

name: restore
doc: Set the signal numbers from the save() dictionary to the saved handler.

name: save
doc: Save the signal handlers to a dictionary mapping signal numbers to the current signal handler.

name: set_memlimit
doc: Set the values for max_memuse and real_max_memuse for big memory tests.

name: setswitchinterval
doc: Set the sys.setswitchinterval() to the given interval. Defines a minimum interval for Android systems to prevent the system from hanging.

name: SHORT_TIMEOUT
doc: Timeout in seconds to mark a test as failed if the test takes “too long”.

name: skip_if_broken_multiprocessing_synchronize
doc: Skip tests if the multiprocessing.synchronize module is missing, if there is no available semaphore implementation, or if creating a lock raises an OSError.

name: sleeping_retry
doc: Wait strategy that applies exponential backoff.

name: SMALLEST
doc: Object that is less than anything (except itself). Used to test mixed type comparison.

name: SOCK_MAX_SIZE
doc: A constant that is likely larger than the underlying OS socket buffer size, to make writes blocking.

name: sortdict
doc: Return a repr of dict with keys sorted.

name: SuppressCrashReport
doc: A context manager used to try to prevent crash dialog popups on tests that are expected to crash a subprocess.

name: swap_attr
doc: Context manager to swap out an attribute with a new object.

name: swap_item
doc: Context manager to swap out an item with a new object.

name: system_must_validate_cert
doc: A decorator that skips the decorated test on TLS certification validation failures.

name: TEST_DATA_DIR
doc: Set to the data directory within the test package.

name: TEST_HOME_DIR
doc: Set to the top level directory for the test package.

name: TEST_HTTP_URL
doc: Define the URL of a dedicated HTTP server for the network tests.

name: TEST_SUPPORT_DIR
doc: Set to the top level directory that contains test.support.

name: TestFailed
doc: Exception to be raised when a test fails. This is deprecated in favor of unittest-based tests and unittest.TestCase’s assertion methods.

name: thread_unsafe
doc: Decorator for marking tests as thread-unsafe. This test always runs in one thread even when invoked with --parallel-threads.

name: unix_shell
doc: Path for shell if not on Windows; otherwise None.

name: verbose
doc: True when verbose output is enabled. Should be checked when more detailed information is desired about a running test. verbose is set by test.regrtest.

name: wait_process
doc: Wait until process pid completes and check that the process exit code is exitcode.

name: with_pymalloc
doc: Return True if Python was built with pymalloc enabled and is not a free-threaded build.
